title: Project Task Billing Method reverts to original value in project card without validation or error
summary: Project Task Billing Method field now persists correctly when changed from One Customer to Multiple Customers, fixing a race condition that previously caused the value to revert without error.
key_points: A Modify() call in the OnValidate trigger ensures the updated billing method value is persisted to the database before the platform refreshes the page
The fix guards against unnecessary modifications by checking if the value actually changed using xRec comparison
Three test cases validate the core fix, the early-exit path when no tasks exist, and prevention of redundant Modify() calls
